title: Network CSV rerun release hardening
summary: Phase 9 completed Network CSV rerun release hardening with aggregate route, contract, WebView, generated-context, dependency-boundary, and change-packet coverage checks.
reason: After Phases 4A through 8, the feature needs a final release gate that verifies route contracts, command confirmations, WebView ownership, generated context, change-packet coverage, and documented real-media limitations before the goal is considered complete.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun implementation and phase-specific validation are complete, but no final release-hardening section records the aggregate contract/static/browser/guardrail gate or the remaining physical remote-worker limitation.
behavior_after: Release hardening records the aggregate validation gate, removes the Pending Publish module-level dependency cycle exposed by postflight, refreshes generated context, keeps dirty paths covered by change packets, and leaves a documented release posture for Network CSV rerun.

rollback_plan: Revert Phase 9 documentation/packet updates only. Do not revert earlier Network CSV rerun implementation packets unless a specific hardening failure requires a targeted rollback, and never delete source media, handoff output, Pending Publish payloads, final outputs, or real-media evidence.
notes:
Phase 9 scope: release hardening and aggregate validation only unless a hardening check exposes a defect. Do not add new Network CSV Rerun operator behavior without a focused test and packet update.
D1 release surface: Network CSV rerun command/read routes, strict command payloads, WebView caller ownership, worker claim/done protocol, destination policy, generated summaries, inventories, and real-media evidence.
D2 validation priority: run targeted contract tests, route inventory tests, WebView static/browser checks, network/rerun integration tests, generated-summary refresh, and strict change-packet coverage.
D3 source safety: no hardening check may mutate operator source roots or final library roots; any real-media artifact use stays in isolated temp roots and is documented.
D4 physical remote-worker limitation: retain the Phase 8 note that no physical SMB worker was available and avoid overstating that coverage. Automated path/claim gating covers code behavior; physical remote proof remains deployment-specific.
D5 docs posture: add a Phase 9 status section to PREWORK rather than creating a new top-level status source.
D6 generated context: refresh generated summaries through tooling after final docs/test edits.
D7 stop conditions: stop if a release check shows route contract drift, missing strict confirmation, uncovered dirty path, WebView mutation ownership drift, stale generated context, source/final-root mutation, or a regression in network claim/done/destination tests.
D8 completion gate: Phase 9 is complete only after strict change-control validation passes with all dirty files covered.
Postflight gap found and fixed: the old Pending Publish result/row/drain-confidence module cycle was removed by moving shared schema constants, int conversion, json-safe conversion, and DTO/command factories into src/mediapipeline/core/publish/pending_contracts.py. Existing public exports from pending_results and pending_rows remain compatible.
Dependency-boundary posture: module-level cycles are now zero. A pre-existing broad package-level cycle remains visible in checker output, but its current package edges are explicitly allowlisted as a temporary baseline for future architecture cleanup so new hard findings still fail.
